extracted.intended_audience: German general public, ZDF viewers, potential employees, contributors and journalists
extracted.subtask_description: Corporate mission and operational principles of a public-service broadcaster (ZDF), covering transparency, accessibility, programme remit, audience engagement, responsibility and employment conditions. Intended to communicate standards and commitments rather than provide a technical how-to.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about mandate and organisation
rubrics_metrics.description: "transparent Informationen über unseren Auftrag, unser Programm, unsere Organisation und unsere Strategie 'Ein ZDF für alle'."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate openly about the broadcaster's legal mandate, programming, organisational structure and strategic goals; make such information publicly accessible on the corporate site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive public-service mission ('Ein ZDF für alle')
rubrics_metrics.description: The strategy motto "Ein ZDF für alle" — commitment to being a public broadcaster for everybody.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design programming and services to serve the whole population, ensuring broad reach and relevance across demographics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience participation and co‑determination (ZDFmitreden)
rubrics_metrics.description: ZDFmitreden is an online community for all of Germany — "mach mit bei unseren Umfragen und nimm Einfluss auf das Programm des ZDF."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide mechanisms (surveys, online communities) for viewers to give feedback and influence programming; use audience input to improve content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of live streaming for events
rubrics_metrics.description: Example: sessions of the 'ARD ZDF Media Stage' at re:publica26 "werden im Livestream übertragen."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make flagship events and important sessions available via live stream so that audiences who cannot attend in person can participate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility to promote education, culture and information
rubrics_metrics.description: The ZDF states its core engagement: "Förderung von Bildung, Kultur und Information."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritise content that informs, educates and supports cultural life; programming should contribute to informed public discourse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support of democratic opinion‑formation and high‑quality journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: "Mit unserem vielfältigen Programmangebot unterstützen wir die Meinungsbildung, stärken die Demokratie und schaffen einen Zugang zu hochwertigem Journalismus für alle."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce and maintain diverse, independent, high‑quality journalistic content that strengthens democratic processes and is accessible to the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility and barrier‑free offerings
rubrics_metrics.description: References such as "Bedienungshilfen für Sehbehinderte" and the heading "Barrierefreie Angebote."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accessibility features (e.g., aids for the visually impaired, barrier‑free formats) so that people with disabilities can access content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability commitment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address ecological and sustainability considerations within organisational practices and public communication; include sustainability as part of corporate responsibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employment quality and diverse career opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: ZDF as employer: "Das ZDF bietet sichere Arbeitsplätze und gute Beschäftigungsbedingungen ... in mehr als 140 verschiedenen Berufsbildern ... nicht nur im journalistischen und redaktionellen Bereich."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer secure jobs and good working conditions across a wide range of professions (editorial, technical, commercial), and communicate career, training and internship opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programmatic diversity and topical breadth
rubrics_metrics.description: Programme topics mentioned: sessions on "Künstlicher Intelligenz und Journalismus, Newsformaten für junge Menschen, Auslands‑ und Sportberichterstattung sowie Medienmacht."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover a broad spectrum of topics and formats (technology, youth formats, international and sports reporting, media power) to address varied audience interests and societal issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of journalist-facing resources and contact points
rubrics_metrics.description: Links/sections: "Ausschreibungen", "Infos für Journalistinnen und Journalisten", "Kontakt zum ZDF."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain dedicated information, calls/tenders and contact channels for journalists and professional stakeholders to facilitate cooperation and information exchange.
